==Background==
"'''Hurray'''" is an original song produced by HoneyWorks featuring Hatsune Miku. It is the official collaboration song for “[https://pocarisweat.jp/action/pocarimiku/pocattego/ Pocari Sweat×Project SEKAI]".

It is Honeyworks’ first work to feature MEIKO. However, it was not uploaded to their own YouTube channel, and is instead featured on the official Hatsune Miku YouTube channel.
